```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
df_unedited <- read_excel(here("Gosnold", "FY26-Town Data-BT-2-20-26.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
# USECODE
# FUELTYPE
# AREASQ
# STORYHEIGHT

df_filtered <- df_unedited %>%
  select(StateClass, FUEL, NetSF, STORIES) %>%
  rename(USECODE = StateClass, FUELTYPE = FUEL, AREASQ = NetSF, STORYHEIGHT = STORIES) %>%
  mutate(USECODE = substr(USECODE, 1, 3))
```

```{r}
write.csv(df_filtered, file = "Gosnold_Final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
